Our services also include the installation and professional commissioning of technologies for wastewater treatment and rainwater management. Our experienced technicians will also train you to run and operate all the technological equipment.

On request, we can deliver the whole build on a turnkey basis, including groundworks, pipe laying and preparation of the electrical installation.
